test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Motor Vehicle) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following terms is associated with the cams that control the valves and directly influence the breathing process of the engine?

options.text: Material of construction of the cams
Shape and timing of the cams
Location and length of the cams

solution:
The correct answer is __Shape and timing of the cams****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The shape and timing of the cams__ are crucial factors that control the valve operation in an engine.
 
• Cams determine the exact timing when the valves open and close during the engine cycle.
 
• The camshaft is designed to regulate the breathing process of the engine, ensuring proper intake and exhaust.
 
• Optimized cam profiles and timing contribute to better engine efficiency and performance.
 
• A malfunction or improper design of the cam can result in engine misfire or reduced performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Material of construction:**
 
 
• Although important for durability, the material does not directly influence the breathing process.
 
• Common materials include cast iron and steel alloys for longevity.
 
 
 
• **Speed of the cams:**
 
 
• The speed correlates with the engine's RPM (revolutions per minute).
 
• However, speed alone does not determine valve timing or breathing efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Location and length of cams:**
 
 
• This refers to the camshaft's physical placement in the engine, which varies between overhead and in-block designs.
 
• It does not directly influence the timing or breathing process.
